transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Saturday, October 24. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Israel launches 'limited counterterrorism' op after 2 IDF troops killed in West Bank. In a post on X, the IDF said, "In response to the shooting attack in which 2 IDF soldiers fell, and several others were wounded, the IDF along with other security forces launched a targeted and limited counterterrorism operation in the Hebron area, from which the terrorists had emerged." The military said residents in areas where its forces are operating would be allowed to leave through three designated exit points. Dan versus Daniel: Trump admin sues to block Alaska result if GOP candidate loses race. The lawsuit, filed in federal court in Alaska on Thursday, argues that the state must protect the integrity of federal elections. It asks the court to block the certification of a Peltola victory if Daniel Sullivan, a candidate from the small fishing community of Petersburg, remains on the ballot. "The United States accordingly brings this lawsuit to protect the integrity of the 2026 Senate election in Alaska," the lawsuit says. Video: Gunmen storm Jordan church during funeral, killing 7 and wounding 40. Jordan's government described the attackers as unknown assailants and said investigations were moving ahead at full speed. It did not immediately confirm whether any suspects had been arrested or killed. Footage aired by Jordanian state television showed two men appearing to carry pistols approaching the church and firing shots. A third man, apparently carrying a semi-automatic rifle, then approached and opened fire before all three ran towards the building. IND versus NZ 2nd T20I: Will Ishan Kishan's injury be Vaibhav Sooryavanshi's gain?. Ishan Kishan has been ruled out of the second T20I match against New Zealand due to a strain. The team management has added uncapped wicketkeeper-batter Kumar Kushagra as a replacement in the squad. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi may finally get an opportunity to play after being on the sidelines for nine matches. Batting coach Sitanshu Kotak emphasized the need for patience regarding Sooryavanshi's exposure to international cricket. Mark Zuckerberg says Meta's Muse chatbot adoption is strong, but AI may not stay free. Meta has launched its AI agent Muse, which is already being used by over 10 million people. CEO Mark Zuckerberg indicated that Muse's revenue potential could surpass that of Facebook and Instagram. Currently, shopping is the most common use case for the Muse agent, with consumers spending an average of $200 per purchase. China's patrolling deviations disturb border: MEA on ITBP DG's face-offs remark. The ministry of external affairs (MEA) on Friday did not go into the specifics of the latest face-off, choosing to refer the issue to the defence ministry, but said Chinese divergence from established patrolling patterns created disturbances at the border from time to time. The official said both sides continued to use existing diplomatic and military mechanisms to resolve outstanding issues and avoid misunderstanding and miscalculation along the LAC. Ontario farmer turned down C$16m for 164 acres; 29 acres protected for 999 years. Charles Stevens and his family have decided to protect Wilmot Orchards by placing a conservation easement on the property. This easement effectively restricts future development for nearly 1,000 years, ensuring continued agricultural use. Their decision counters pressures from developers seeking to convert farmland into housing. The Stevens family aims to preserve the land for future generations of farmers. Shreyas Iyer on verge of breaking Rohit Sharma's unique T20I captaincy record. Iyer, who took over as India's T20I captain from Suryakumar Yadav in June, has scored 632 runs in 22 matches as skipper this year. Upper layer NBFCs have to list: RBI guv on Tatas; dispels doubts on Sept order. RBI governor Sanjay Malhotra's comments also suggest Tata Sons is in breach of RBI rules. The consequences of continued noncompliance remain unclear. The governor declined to be drawn into the question of Noel Tata's proposal to merge two Tata Sons subsidiaries with the holding company, a move that could help it sidestep a stock market listing. Trump eases tariffs on Canadian imports weeks before US midterms. The White House said the changes would remove tariffs on certain products, including "plywood sheets, some paper products, certain machinery and refrigeration equipment". However, the administration will also introduce tariffs on other goods, including carpets, certain valves and waste products. The new measures will take effect on October 30. The United States and Canada have closely connected economies.

Sebi orders Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy and its founder to refund rupees 546 cr. Markets regulator Sebi on Friday directed Avadhut Sathe Trading Academy Pvt Ltd (ASTAPL) and its Founder Avadhut Sathe to refund rupees 546.17 crore collected from participants for providing unregistered investment advisory and research analyst services, along with interest of rupees 67.87 crore. The regulator has also barred the academy and Sathe from accessing the securities market for two years or until compliance with the refund direction, whichever is later. In its 171-page final order, the regulator imposed a total penalty of rupees 11.5 crore on the academy, Sathe and Gouri Avadhut Sathe for violations of securities market regulations. The academy has been fined rupees 6 crore, Sathe has been fined rupees 4 crore, while Gouri Avadhut Sathe has been penalised rupees 1.5 crore. IPO Subscription status comparison: Reliance Jio IPO versus Hyundai IPO versus NSE IPO - Who won the race?. It is set to surpass Hyundai Motor India's 2024 IPO as India's biggest-ever offering. Sebi eases call-recording mandate for research analysts dealing with funds. Market regulator Sebi on Friday eased the mandatory requirement for research analysts to maintain call recordings of their interactions with institutional investors to reduce compliance burden and improve ease of doing business. In a circular, the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) said research analysts and entities will no longer be mandatorily required to maintain call recordings of interactions with institutional investors. However, they will continue to be required to maintain records of their interactions with all clients, including prospective clients, through means such as signed physical records, emails, SMS messages, call recordings or any other legally verifiable method. The records are required to be maintained for five years. Sebi bars Avadhut Sathe, academy from markets, imposes rupees 11.5 crore penalty. In a final order issued on Friday, the market regulator directed ASTAPL and its founder Avadhut Dinkar Sathe to disgorge and refund rupees 546.17 crore to eligible investors and participants who paid for its unregistered services. Here is a comparison of top FD rates across banks for 1-year, 3-year, and 5-year tenures. 366 percent return on SGB final redemption: Gold bond turns rupees 1 lakh investment into rupees 4.66 lakh; check details. The Reserve Bank of India has finalized the redemption price for future Sovereign Gold Bonds, allowing investors to redeem them early after a five-year period. This price is based on recent average gold closing prices. Insurance regulation: Reform must strengthen the market, not weaken its foundations. Proposed changes to insurance commissions could reshape distribution, jobs and access to protection. Reform must be backed by evidence of lower costs and better consumer outcomes. Paid rupees 1.15 lakh to move goods to Nagaland, got damaged TV and 23 missing items; what did consumer commission order?. After her belongings were delayed, damaged and partly lost during a Delhi-to-Nagaland move, Longchar sought compensation. The consumer commission held the movers deficient in service and rejected Urban Company's claim that it was merely an intermediary. DA hike news 2026: Gift ahead of Diwali for government employees of this state; rupees 10k arrears also for Class IV staff. This state government has raised the Dearness Allowance (DA) from 45 percent to 50 percent for eligible employees. The additional DA will be paid with the October 2026 salary in November, while arrears from July 2023 and January 2024 to September 2026 will be paid separately as prescribed. rupees 10,000 monthly in Post Office RD versus PPF: Which investment builds a bigger corpus in 15 years? Returns compared. Investing rupees 10,000 monthly in Post Office RD or PPF can help build long-term savings. Compare October-December 2026 interest rates, investment tenure, maturity, tax benefits and reinvestment requirements before choosing a scheme. Bank of Baroda festive campaign: Bank launches offers on home, car and other loans; debit cards and savings accounts for women. Bank of Baroda has initiated a festive campaign providing various retail and MSME loan options for customers. The campaign includes home loan interest rates starting from 7.40 percent with waived processing fees for eligible borrowers. Dearness Allowance July 2026: How much could your monthly salary increase with 1 percent , 2 percent or 3 percent DA hike? Check formula. Central government employees await the July 2026 DA hike announcement. If DA rises from 60 percent to 61 percent , 62 percent or 63 percent , employees with a basic pay of rupees 18,000 could receive rupees 180, rupees 360 or rupees 540 more per month, respectively. transcript.title: Science and technology
transcript.text: Next, science and technology. HMD 2660 Flip Senior Edition with AI Companion: What it offers specifically for senior citizens. AI companion Mary is available around the clock and can discuss topics such as history and nature, share stories, answer questions, play memory games or simply listen. Xbox's first chief operating officer is out after just a few months. Xbox's first chief operating officer (COO) is leaving after the new role was created just a few months ago. Helen Chiang is leaving Microsoft today, according to an internal Xbox memo seen by The Verge. Chiang has been at Microsoft for 21 years, serving as the head of Minecraft before being promoted to Xbox chief Startups don't need to go viral to win customers. At TechCrunch Disrupt last week, two founders and a VC discussed how to not just gain an early following but keep one. One of Earth's most powerful supervolcanoes is refilling with fresh magma. Deep beneath Japan's Kikai caldera, a massive magma reservoir is refilling 7,300 years after one of the most powerful volcanic eruptions in Earth's recent geological history. Scientists used underwater seismic surveys to reveal a vast store of magma that appears to have accumulated since the ancient catastrophe. The discovery could help explain how supervolcanoes like Yellowstone and Toba rebuild their magma supplies. Vivo X500 series Europe launch on October 27: Expected camera specs, battery capacity and key features. The vivo X500 series is expected to focus on photography, video recording and AI-powered productivity. OpenAI now trains its frontier AI models with no internet access. OpenAI is now training its most advanced AI models without internet access following a string of rogue hacking incidents. In a blog post on Friday, OpenAI says it built an offline testing environment where AI models can interact with indexed and cached web content "without risk of affecting external systems." OpenAI paused training its frontier OpenAI says it will no longer train its AI models on the live internet, citing "significant risks". OpenAI will cut frontier models off from the internet weeks after one of its engineers said that solution wouldn't work. Nearly 20 percent of Switzerland's glacier ice has vanished in just five years. Switzerland's glaciers are disappearing at an alarming rate, losing more than 5 percent of their ice volume in 2026 alone. Some of the country's most famous glaciers experienced their worst melting on record, while several smaller glaciers vanished completely. Nearly 20 percent of Switzerland's glacier ice has disappeared in just five years, driven by unusually snowless winters and extreme summer heat. Apple iPhone 17 Pro price drops to rupees 72,050 on Flipkart with exchange and bank offers: Check how the deal works. Apple iPhone 17 Pro (256GB) is available at an effective price of rupees 72,050 on Flipkart, against its listed price of rupees 1,34,900. Buyers can get an exchange discount of rupees 57,850 on an eligible iPhone 16 Pro, along with an additional rupees 5,000 HDFC Bank discount. Abandoned Popcorn Time apps had to be disabled to prevent a zombie army. Remember Popcorn Time, the app that served as an easy-to-use front end for streaming torrents of movies and TV shows? Development of the MPAA's least-favorite app of the 2010s has been abandoned for years, but the "Netflix of Piracy" software is still installed on millions of devices that are just waiting to join a bot Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell. The robots, stomping their little feet and making tiny R2-D2 noises, sat, fell down dead for a "nap," and summersaulted on voice command. Dental implants can hijack your immune system, scientists discover. Researchers have uncovered a surprising reason dental implant infections often resist antibiotics: the implants themselves can contribute to the problem. Bacteria corrode titanium implants, releasing microscopic particles that hijack immune cells, trigger destructive inflammation, and accelerate jawbone loss. Vivo Y600 with Guinness record-holding 10,000mAh battery to launch next week: Check date, design and expected specs. Vivo Y600 5G will launch in China on October 30, featuring a massive 10,000mAh battery and a design revealed in white and blue colour options. The smartphone reportedly achieved a Guinness World Records title after completing a continuous livestream test lasting 32 hours and 37 minutes. Jack Dorsey's Block made an AI model that talks to you like an awkward new friend. Jack Dorsey's Block announced an AI model called Dessa that's trained "from scratch on nothing but human conversation," and to show off the model, Block shared chats it has had with humans that can occasionally be a little awkward and uncanny. Take this one, for example, shared by Dessa lead Ragavan Thurairatnam. The conversation between VCs, Superhuman Mail founder share red flags about product-market fit. Top investors from Iconiq and Sapphire Ventures, along with Rahul Vohra, the founder of Superhuman Mail, share the do's and don'ts for building hit products. Cambridge scientists create a $10 chip that could put a medical lab on your wrist. Cambridge researchers have created a groundbreaking $10 optical sensor that delivers the precision of laboratory equipment in a device small enough for wearable technology. It identified foods, plastics, and medicines with 100 percent accuracy in tests and demonstrated the ability to monitor blood glucose, alcohol, and other health markers without invasive procedures. Oppo Find X10 and X10 Pro Max launched in India: Triple 200MP cameras, 8,000 mAh battery, check price. Oppo has launched the Find X10 and Find X10 Pro Max in India, featuring up to three 200MP rear cameras, batteries of up to 8,000mAh and AI-powered tools. Soundcore's latest noise-crushing headphones are on sale for a new low price. My colleague John Higgins considered Soundcore's Space One some of the best budget noise-canceling headphones you could buy when they launched in 2023 , and their successor has only improved upon their winning formula, albeit with a $30 price increase. Thankfully, the Soundcore Space 2 are currently on sale at Amazon, Best Buy, and Walmart TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 roundtables: Go deeper on the challenges founders are solving right now. TechCrunch Founder Summit 2026 is coming to SoWa Power Station in Boston on November 4, bringing founders, investors, and operators together for a full day of candid conversations, practical sessions, live pitching, networking, and smaller roundtables built for deeper discussion. Breakthrough PTSD treatment achieves 68 percent remission rate in clinical trial. A newly FDA-cleared PTSD treatment uses personalized brain mapping and magnetic stimulation to target abnormal brain activity, with a clinical trial reporting a 52 percent reduction in symptoms and 68 percent remission. Researchers believe the technology could transform PTSD care and pave the way for more precise treatments for other mental health conditions. Polish PM Donald Tusk seeks deeper technology cooperation with India across AI, digital and space sectors. Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk has called for stronger technology partnerships between India and Poland, highlighting opportunities for companies from both countries across sectors including artificial intelligence (AI) solutions, digital products and space technology.

Why India's data problem is not about data alone. India and Sri Lanka strengthen cultural ties through shared Buddhist heritage. transcript.title: Across India
transcript.text: Turning to the big national stories. After Operation Sindoor friction, Delhi and Baku reset ties with EAM Jaishankar's visit. Ties between the two countries had been held back by geopolitical reasons for a while, mainly Azerbaijan's ties with Pakistan , as evident from its support for Islamabad after Op Sindoor last year , and India's defence ties with Armenia. While Bayramov spoke about taking the relationship to a higher level, setting aside past differences, Jaishankar underlined the significance of trade and energy cooperation. Terrorism was also discussed. Cabinet secretariat merely acknowledged complaint of ECs against senior poll officer: RTI. Explaining the rationale behind the reluctance to take any action, a confidential note on the file shared by the Cabinet secretariat with transparency activist, Commodore Lokesh K Batra (Retd), as part of its 21-page RTI reply, stated that EC being a Constitutional body is insulated from the Executive's interference by design. China's patrolling deviations disturb border: MEA on ITBP DG's LAC face-offs remark. The ministry of external affairs (MEA) on Friday did not go into the specifics of the latest face-off, choosing to refer the issue to the defence ministry, but said Chinese divergence from established patrolling patterns created disturbances at the border from time to time. The official said both sides continued to use existing diplomatic and military mechanisms to resolve outstanding issues and avoid misunderstanding and miscalculation along the LAC. Centre bans reuse of single-use medical devices across hospitals; flags recycling of disposables. In a letter dated Oct 16, the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) said it had come to its notice that some private and corporate hospitals were reusing single-use devices after sterilising them, including items used in cardiology, nephrology, oncology, cardiothoracic and vascular surgery (CTVS), neurosurgery and other clinical services. The DGHS said that reuse could expose patients to cross-infection, device malfunction, reduced performance and other complications. Brics parliamentary meet should end with joint statement: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla. Talking to reporters Friday, Birla said the forum in India would work towards consensus-based dialogue on the role of Parliament in strengthening institutions, promotion of human-centred innovation in AI and digital technologies through Parliament, more representative system of global governance and role of Parliament in ensuring a sustainable and inclusive future for Brics countries. Gurjar Mahasabha flags lack of political representation, seeks greater share in legislatures, institutions. Scheduled for October 27, the Akhil Bharatiya Gurjar Mahasabha's national convention aims to tackle pressing representation issues faced by the Gurjar community, evidenced by just 20 MLAs in a pool of approximately 4,600 across India. Key demands include the formation of a Gurjar Regiment and reserved positions, as well as initiatives focused on youth development and substance abuse awareness. Parl panel bats for intercensal surveys, gender-inclusive census town norms. A parliamentary panel has called for "intercensal surveys" -- surveys between two successive censuses -- in India considering that cities and urban settlements undergo major changes in 10 years, and has also recommended review of the criteria for notifying "census towns" to make it more gender inclusive. Jamia protest: Congress MP Imran Masood detained, SP MP alleges manhandling by police. Delhi Police on Friday detained Congress MP Imran Masood after he joined the students' protest at Jamia Milia University. Fodder scam accused nabbed after 25 years, had fled to Nepal. Ending a quarter-century-long game of hide-and-seek, CBI has arrested Satyendra Kumar, a key fugitive wanted in connection with Bihar's infamous Fodder scam. After Sindoor friction, India and Azerbaijan reset ties with EAM visit. Amid ongoing efforts by both India and Azerbaijan for a reset in ties, external affairs minister S Jaishankar and his counterpart Jeyhun Bayramov agreed to expand cooperation in energy, trade, investment and connectivity in a "very productive" meeting in Baku. UP polls: Congress shares initial list with SP, seeks 175-200 seats. The Congress has formally begun seat-sharing negotiations with the Samajwadi Party (SP) in poll-bound Uttar Pradesh, submitting an initial list of more than 175 assembly constituencies to the Akhilesh Yadav-led party. Siddaramaiah cries blackmail over 'fake sting' video, alleges conspiracy. Former Karnataka chief minister Siddaramaiah on Friday said he had lodged a police complaint over an alleged "fake sting operation" video targeting him, alleging that it was an attempt to blackmail him after he lost power. 'There will be no privatisation': Haryana CM assures power employees as electricity union calls off strike. Haryana's striking electricity employees on Friday called off their three-day strike following a meeting with chief minister Nayab Singh Saini and power minister Anil Vij. Delhi HC rejects AISA chief Neha Bora's plea against police notice to sign peace bond. The Delhi high court rejected a plea filed by All India Students' Association (AISA) president Neha Bora challenging a police notice directing her to execute a bond for "keeping peace" before a Special Executive Magistrate. Evening news wrap: Delhi police detain SIR protesters marching towards EC headquarters; Jordan church shooting leaves seven dead and more. Delhi Police detained protesters marching towards the Election Commission headquarters against the SIR of electoral rolls, as authorities imposed restrictions on public gatherings.Raj Thackeray accused the BJP of undermining democracy amid a political row over an audio clip alleging a rupees 500 crore payment to Maratha quota activist Manoj Jarange.At least seven people were killed and around 10 injured after two gunmen opened fire at a church during a funeral procession in Jordan's Karak region.Jared Kushner rejected allegations of secret foreign bank accounts and hundreds of millions of dollars in transfers linked to Israel, the UAE and Saudi Arabia, calling the claims fabrications.A Delhi court allowed American national Matthew Aaron VanDyke to travel to the US and extended permission for six Ukrainian nationals to remain outside India until February 24 in a case involving alleged training of armed groups in Myanmar.Here are your top stories of the day

transcript.title: Around the world
transcript.text: And finally, here is what is happening around the world. Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says. One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks. The suspected gunman has been apprehended. Freed US citizen was tortured in Russian jail, former Ukrainian prisoners say. Ukrainians held alongside the American say they witnessed beatings and sexual humiliation by Russian guards during his detention. Argentina drops investigation into President Milei over crypto fraud. Javier Milei had denied acting fraudulently when a cryptocurrency nosedived after he deleted a social media post about it. Ukraine says Starlink still restricted after Trump says limits lifted. The network is used by the Ukrainian military, sources say, and Trump says "if there is a problem, I'll get it straightened out".
